name: Minimal Collective
mood: stark editorial black with gallery restraint
summary: A severe black-gallery editorial style using pure black, white, muted gray, PolySans regular, huge tightly tracked type, hairline dividers, ghost pill controls, square overlapping photography, and no chromatic accent.

typography.fallback: Suisse Int'l, Neue Haas Grotesk, Inter, Arial

layout.model: black editorial canvas with sparse nav, oversized type, overlapping image compositions, hairline dividers, and no card stack

elevation.depth: overlap, contrast, scale, and hairline structure

dos: Use only black, white, and muted gray.
Use one regular sans weight across the system.
Make display typography enormous and tightly tracked.
Use hairline dividers instead of shadows.
Use square image crops and intentional overlap.
Keep copy short, sparse, and editorial.
donts: Do not add a colored CTA or accent hue.
Do not use gradients, glows, or soft shadows.
Do not create rounded card stacks.
Do not use playful icons or illustrations.
Do not use multiple font families.
Do not fill the page with dense controls or dashboard UI.
